_readme: Organisations ROR cannot settle, and what to do about each.
ROR answers for 89.6% of this corpus's institution links and stays the
authority. This file is only for the three things it does not settle:
parent   ROR holds the country records but no edge between them.
Google (Ireland) has parent Google (United States); Nvidia
(United Kingdom) and Nvidia (United States) have no parent at
all, so they rank as two unrelated companies. `parent` groups
them without pretending either record is the other.
canonical  ROR has no record. Shanghai Innovation Institute (2025),
Zhongguancun Academy and Galbot are real and simply too new.
`canonical` fixes one spelling so counts do not split.
exclude  Not an organisation. 'Independent Researcher' appears on 41
papers and is a statement that there is no affiliation.
Keys are folded names: lowercase, accents removed. Add an entry only when
a real affiliation is seen to fall through; a hand-kept list that
duplicates ROR will drift out of date and be trusted anyway.
`seen` records the paper count at the time of the entry. It is a note for
whoever reads this next, not something the code uses.

nvidia.note: ROR splits Nvidia (United States) / (United Kingdom) / (India) with no parent edge, unlike Google and Microsoft

meta.note: Meta (United States) and the Facebook-era records carry no parent edge

amd.note: seven country records, no parent edge

microsoft research.note: ROR holds Microsoft Research (United Kingdom) and (India) under Microsoft (United States); the bare name matches both

georgia tech.note: matches the country of Georgia as well as the institute

northwestern institute on complex system.note: NICO is a Northwestern centre; ROR holds no record for it

purdue university.note: ROR has it; the local dump's name table does not, so the lookup misses
